Netanyahu cites India's support to counter US official's ally claim

U.S. Vice President JD Vance stated that Donald Trump is the only head of state sympathetic to Israel. In response, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu countered Vance's remarks by highlighting the support Israel receives from India, mentioning its large population. This exchange occurred during a news briefing at the White House.
